reason: Two founders and a first pilot club that isn't even live yet: I can't take that to our ALV with 1,350 members' data and invoicing on the line. Our current system works well enough, and €599 a month plus migration is real money on top of what we already pay.
objection: No reference club running it for a full season. If two founders stop or get sick, my members' bookings and billing are stuck, and I'm the one who has to explain that to the members' meeting.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three comparable clubs of our size running it live for at least a season, that I can call myself, plus a clear exit clause and data export if it doesn't work.
